description: 按E39已存提案登记不同中电联原对象的固定1/2月源资格；先有限旧用途定位，不修改原月/全国/当月定义或任何模型。
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import hashlib,json,subprocess
ROOT=Path.cwd();REL='reports/research/510300_cec_national_single_month_electricity_source_qualification_v1';OUT=ROOT/REL
assert not OUT.exists(),'E40固定来源资格已登记，不重启。'
ref='reports/research/510300_electricity_physical_quantity_source_qualification_v1'
proposal=json.loads((ROOT/(ref+'/next_experiment.json')).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert proposal['experiment_id']=='E40' and proposal['fixed_stat_months']==['2024-01','2024-02']
parents=[ref+'/next_experiment.json',ref+'/protocol.json',ref+'/result.json',ref+'/source_gate.json',
ref+'/原公开收件_全部.json',ref+'/全部实际原周期与用电字段.json',ref+'/固定三月原单月资格.json',
ref+'/不同公布值衔接残差_不重构缺失单月.csv',ref+'/当前用电原字段旧用途_有限复核.json',
'reports/research/510300_purchase_quantity_cause_increment_v1/protocol.json',
'reports/research/510300_purchase_quantity_cause_increment_v1/result.json']
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
OUT.mkdir()
proto={'study_id':'510300_CEC_NATIONAL_SINGLE_MONTH_ELECTRICITY_SOURCE_QUALIFICATION_V1','experiment_id':'E40',
 'registered_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),
 'status':'DISTINCT_ORIGINAL_PUBLISHER_SOURCE_ONLY_REGISTERED_BEFORE_PUBLIC_LOOKUP',
 'prior_goal_turn_classification':'PROGRESS_E39_ACTUAL_NATIONAL_ELECTRICITY_ORIGINAL_PERIODS_AND_NON_ADDITIVITY_EVIDENCE',
 'question':proposal['question'],'candidate_source':proposal['candidate_source'],'why_allowed':proposal['why_allowed'],
 'fixed_stat_months':proposal['fixed_stat_months'],'desired_fields':proposal['desired_fields'],
 'parents':[{'path':p,'sha256':sha(ROOT/p),'bytes':(ROOT/p).stat().st_size} for p in parents],
 'local_march_control':proposal['local_control'],'source_gate':proposal['source_gate'],
 'prior_use_check':proposal['prior_use_check'],'budget':proposal['budget'],
 'source_clock':'原发布/转载/URL目录/当前实际收件时点分别保存，未认证首次不可变版不写成已认证；原文日内发布时间没有就UNKNOWN。',
 'source_identity':'只接受全国用电消费对应当月原行，明确根发布机构与出处；不将同稿转载当独立证据或别省/发电量/累计量替代。',
 'budget_counting':'每search_query的q计1；每原对象HTTP GET计1，预算2；重定向不自动跟随，不请求凭据或扩未登记目录。',
 'stop':proposal['stop'],'E39_preserved':proposal['E39_preserved'],
 'model_followup':'本来源实验没有预测/拟合或完整训练阶段，有限源通过也不代表目标达成。',
 'source_code_edits':0,'new_labels':0,'new_models':0,'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,
 'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET',
 'orders_authorized':False,'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,'live_process':False,'goal_achieved':False,
 'dr007_dependency':proposal['dr007_dependency']}
(OUT/'protocol.json').write_text(json.dumps(proto,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
args=['rg','-n','--max-columns','1600','--max-columns-preview','--glob','*.py','--glob','*.json',
 '--glob','!*access*','--glob','!*provider*','--glob','!*credential*','--glob','!*local*','--glob','!*secret*','--glob','!*token*',
 '中电联|cec.org.cn|全国.*单月.*用电|electricity_consumption','research','config']
r=subprocess.run(args,cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace')
assert r.returncode in [0,1],r.stderr[:1000]
obj={'command':args,'matches':r.stdout.splitlines(),'status':'EXPLICIT_CEC_SOURCE_FIELD_LOCATORS_ONLY',
 'limits':'仅当前源码/配置的明确发布对象/字段；自身提案文字不是旧计算用途，无命中不证明穷尽全历史。'}
(OUT/'不同原发布对象旧用途_有限定位.json').write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'registered':proto['study_id'],'months':proto['fixed_stat_months'],'parents':len(parents),
 'budget':proto['budget'],'prior_use_matches':len(obj['matches'])},ensure_ascii=False))
for line in obj['matches'][:6]:print(line[:800])
